name: 7 Card Draw
description: 7 Card Draw: each player gets seven cards, then may draw/discard (typically once) to improve. Best five-card hand wins. Less common than 5 Card Draw; often limit or pot-limit. USA.

overview.description: 7 Card Draw: each player gets seven cards, then may draw/discard (typically once) to improve. Best five-card hand wins. Less common than 5 Card Draw; often limit or pot-limit. USA.

history.origins: American draw poker variant; seven cards instead of five, one (or two) draw round(s). Less common than 5 Card Draw; popular in home and dealer's choice games.
timeline: Early 20th century: Draw poker variants (5 and 7 card)
Present: 7 Card Draw in mixed and home games

rules.objective: Make the best five-card poker hand from your seven cards after the draw.
rules.gameplay: Each player receives seven cards. Betting round; then each player discards and draws (typically once) to replace discarded cards. Final betting; showdown; best five-card hand wins.
keyRules: Seven cards each; one (or two) draw round(s)

strategy.basic: Draw for straights and flushes; bet with pairs and two-pair.
strategy.intermediate: Position and draw size; read opponents' draw patterns.
strategy.advanced: Bluff draws; value-bet made hands; 7 cards = more redraws.
tips: Seven cards, one draw round; best five cards.

variations.name: With Ante
variations.description: All players post an ante in addition to (or instead of) small and big blinds before the deal.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variation only changes whether antes are used; base engine covers betting structure.

variations.name: Two Draw Rounds
variations.description: Some play with two drawing rounds, each followed by a betting round, instead of a single draw.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variation describes common home-game rule of two draw rounds without changing core engine phases.
